title: Identification and mechanistic exploration of structural and conformational dynamics of NF-kB inhibitors: rationale insights from in silico and in vitro studies.
authors: Srivastava, Amit Kumar; Srivastava, Shubham; Kumar, Viney; Ghosh, Souvik; Yadav, Siddharth; Malik, Ruchi; Roy, Partha; Prasad, Ramasare
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过虚拟筛选、分子对接和MD模拟探究NF-kB小分子抑制剂与靶蛋白的结合机制，虽涉及蛋白-配体互作和构象动态，但对象为蛋白-小分子而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且未涉及TF-DNA结合建模，仅方法部分可借鉴。
abstract: Increased expression of target genes that code for proinflammatory chemical mediators results from a series of intracellular cascades triggered by activation of dysregulated NF-kappaB signaling pathway. Dysfunctional NF-kB signaling amplifies and perpetuates autoimmune responses in inflammatory diseases, including psoriasis. This study aimed to identify therapeutically relevant NF-kB inhibitors and elucidate the mechanistic aspects behind NF-kB inhibition. After virtual screening and molecular docking, five hit NF-kB inhibitors opted, and their therapeutic efficacy was examined using cell-based assays in TNF-alpha stimulated human keratinocyte cells. To investigate the conformational changes of target protein and inhibitor-protein interaction mechanisms, molecular dynamics (MD) simulations, binding free energy calculations together with principal component (PC) analysis, dynamics cross-correlation matrix analysis (DCCM), free energy landscape (FEL) analysis and quantum mechanical calculations were carried out. Among identified NF-kB inhibitors, myricetin and hesperidin significantly scavenged intracellular ROS and inhibited NF-kB activation. Analysis of the MD simulation trajectories of ligand-protein complexes revealed that myricetin and hesperidin formed energetically stabilized complexes with the target protein and were able to lock NF-kB in a closed conformation. Myricetin and hesperidin binding to the target protein significantly impacted conformational changes and internal dynamics of amino acid residues in protein domains. Tyr57, Glu60, Lys144 and Asp239 residues majorly contributed to locking the NF-kB in a closed conformation. The combinatorial approach employing in silico tools integrated with cell-based approaches substantiated the binding mechanism and NF-kB active site inhibition by the lead molecule myricetin, which can be explored as a viable antipsoriatic drug candidate associated with dysregulated NF-kB.Communicated by Ramaswamy H. Sarma.
abstract_zh: 编码促炎化学介质的目标基因表达增加，是由失调的NF-kappaB信号通路激活触发的一系列细胞内级联反应所致。功能失调的NF-kB信号在炎症性疾病（包括银屑病）中放大并持续自身免疫反应。本研究旨在识别具有治疗相关性的NF-kB抑制剂，并阐明NF-kB抑制背后的机制方面。经过虚拟筛选和分子对接，选出了五种命中NF-kB抑制剂，并在TNF-α刺激的人角质形成细胞中通过基于细胞的检测评估了其治疗效果。为研究靶蛋白的构象变化及抑制剂-蛋白相互作用机制，进行了分子动力学 (molecular dynamics, MD) 模拟、结合自由能计算，以及主成分 (principal component, PC) 分析、动力学交叉相关矩阵分析 (dynamics cross-correlation matrix analysis, DCCM)、自由能景观 (free energy landscape, FEL) 分析和量子力学计算。在已识别的NF-kB抑制剂中，杨梅素和橙皮苷显著清除细胞内ROS并抑制NF-kB激活。对配体-蛋白复合物MD模拟轨迹的分析显示，杨梅素和橙皮苷与靶蛋白形成了能量稳定的复合物，并能将NF-kB锁定在闭合构象中。杨梅素和橙皮苷与靶蛋白的结合显著影响了蛋白结构域中氨基酸残基的构象变化和内部动力学。Tyr57、Glu60、Lys144和Asp239残基在将NF-kB锁定于闭合构象中起主要作用。采用整合基于细胞方法的计算机模拟工具的组合策略，证实了先导分子杨梅素的结合机制及对NF-kB活性位点的抑制，该分子可被探索为与失调NF-kB相关的可行抗银屑病药物候选物。由Ramaswamy H. Sarma通讯。
